name: Asahi Songwon Colors Ltd
tagline: NSE: ASAHISONG | Microcap pigment manufacturer, Ahmedabad, Gujarat
business_overview: Incorporated in 1990, Asahi Songwon is a leading manufacturer of blue (Phthalocyanine) pigments - CPC Blue Crude, Pigment Alpha/Beta Blue - for ink, plastics, paint, textile and paper industries, and has expanded into yellow/red/orange (AZO) pigments and APIs.
source_notes: Source sheet grouped it with Gujarat Containers as having 'similar solid engagement levels on positive results posts.' ValuePickr has a long-running thread ('Asahi Songwon - Steady Performer') reflecting a multi-year value-investor following.
fundamentals_narrative: A genuine profit inflection is visible in the last two quarters (PAT jumped from Rs 2 Cr to Rs 11 Cr to Rs 19 Cr sequentially) even as TTM sales growth is flat-to-slightly-negative - meaning the improvement is margin-driven, not volume-driven, which is a meaningfully different (and less certain) story than a demand-led recovery. Screener flags a low 3-year ROE (~5%) and a note that the company 'might be capitalizing the interest cost' - worth independent verification as it can flatter reported profit if true. Reasonable P/B (1.6x) for a business showing genuine margin recovery.
